anchor: ATO Phase 1 — per-sector turnover bands in USD per year, adopted from the ATO Small Business Benchmarks framework. Each sector gets three bands: small / medium / large. Country-level conversion uses each country's PPP factor at render time. Phase 1 ships six sentinel sectors with realistic per-sector thresholds; Phase 6 will populate all 25 sectors and override at the industry-id level where needed.
convention: Bands are inclusive of the lower bound, exclusive of the upper. The third (large) band has no upper bound (null = open-ended). Currency: USD per year. PPP-adjusted at render time per country.
